impact.text: The attacker then calls `ServiceManager.activateRegistration()` and only pays the reduced bond amount;

precondition_sources.text: The attacker is a service owner (malicious service creator) able to create a service.
The attacker creates a service with a single agent and specifies a large USDC bond.

intent_sources.text: Service creation must finalize all token-bond state (createWithToken) before any external call such as ServiceRegistry.create()/_safeMint, so reentrancy cannot alter bond parameters between capture and use.
ServiceManager.create() and ServiceManager.update() must be protected against reentrancy.

impact.text: Finally, the attacker terminates the service and withdraws the originally specified USDC bond from `ServiceRegistryTokenUtility`, effectively draining its funds.

precondition_sources.text: The attacker is a service owner (malicious service creator) able to create a service.
The attacker creates a service with a single agent and specifies a large USDC bond.
ServiceRegistryTokenUtility holds a USDC balance from which the bond is drawn.

intent_sources.text: Service creation must finalize all token-bond state (createWithToken) before any external call such as ServiceRegistry.create()/_safeMint, so reentrancy cannot alter bond parameters between capture and use.
ServiceManager.create() and ServiceManager.update() must be protected against reentrancy.
